incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: billing.keystore-sync lag detected — token-emit pipeline falling behind. spike in token_count_delta across regions. Severity: P2.
incident-bot: Symptoms: delayed usage emits, intermittent overage flags, aggregation windows showing negative drift. Affected services: billing-emitter, metering-aggregator.
oncall: Picking this up. quick check — is this the same keystore replication lag from last month? :thinking_face:
alex.g: looks related, Primary keystore (postgres) had a long vacuum/replication stall around 01:12 UTC. ISee WAL lag ~15m for replica-2.
maria.p: :eyes: customer alerting? Any paid customers hitting overage notices?
sam.s: Checked dashboard — ~12 accounts flagged with provisional overage emails between 01:30–01:42 UTC. No invoices yet, just threshold alerts.
priya.r: Running the recon job now to compare emitter vs ledger: `./scripts/recon_token_counts --since 2026-03-18T01:00Z --to 2026-03-18T02:00Z`
alex.g: Good. Meanwhile I will promote a read from replica-1 to reduce WAL lag for the emitter. Switching emitter reads to fallback-keystore (read-only) for the next 10m. Command: `kubectl set env deploy/billing-emitter KEYSTORE_HOST=fallback-keystore.internal`
oncall: Please post runbook id. Also let's hold billing alerts to customers while we verify.
maria.p: Runbook: billing-keystore-sync-incident v3. Step 1 = pause outbound overage emails (`/runbooks/pause-billing-alerts`). I'm pausing now.
sam.s: paused alerts. Verified via `alertmgr silenced: billing.overage_emails`
incident-bot: NOTE: automated fallback policy engaged: emitter -> fallback-keystore. Telemetry: token_emit_rate down 8%, backlog queue length rising.
priya.r: Recon finished — preliminary: emitter shows +48k tokens emitted that are not in ledger for window 01:10–01:40. Likely duplicate/replay from retry logic when keystore reads failed.
alex.g: I see retry storm from emitter logs. Patch idea: temporarily disable emitter retry backoff amplification and enable idempotency check (idempotency_key header enforcement). Deploying small patch to staging now.
maria.p: Customer impact assessment: no invoices yet; risk window for false overage flags until recon completes. Recommend manual review for accounts with spikes >10x baseline.
oncall: Oncall handoff in 15m — if unresolved, escalate to SRE lead. Also advise CS to hold outbound messages. @maria.p can you coordinate?
maria.p: Yup, pinged CS with collection of affected account IDs. Ask them to prepare a templated message if we need to send corrective follow-up.
sam.s: Workaround: I've kicked a dedupe job that will reconcile emitter ids with ledger. Command: `airflow trigger_dag reconcile_emitter_ledger_v2` — expect completion ~20m.
incident-bot: ACTIONS LOGGED: pause-alerts, switch-emitter-read, trigger-reconcile.
priya.r: Reconcile job progress: 30% done, scanning by account shards. Early matches show ~90% duplicates are transient.
alex.g: Rolling the idempotency check to canary (1 pod). If no errors in 5m, scale to full emitter.
incident-bot: UPDATE: canary OK. No increase in error rate, WAL lag decreasing.
oncall: Good progress. Keep thread updates concise. Last check before handoff in 10m.
maria.p: CS prepared template. If we conclude no billing adjustments needed, we will still send an FYI to the 12 affected customers with an apology and explanation.
sam.s: Reconcile finished: mismatched tokens corrected, provisional overage alerts retracted. Running a final validation: `SELECT count(*) FROM provisional_overages WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-18T01:00:00Z'` = 0 after retract job.
priya.r: Confirm ledger and emitter counts within 0.2% across windows. No invoices generated.
oncall: Handing off to next oncall. Summary posted to #incidents-history. Good work. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: root cause = postgres replica WAL lag leading to keystore read failures and emitter retry duplicates. Mitigation = switch reads to fallback-keystore, pause alerts, run dedupe/reconcile, deploy idempotency check. Postmortem assigned to alex.g and priya.r.
